description: Location-based duplicate IP reporting for 7-day and 30-day operating windows. Uses duplicate IP snapshots captured by the application and filters affected phones by proxy location.

panels.description: Distinct duplicated outbound IPs observed in the selected time range for the selected proxy locations.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT x.last_ip) AS value
FROM duplicate_ip_snapshot_rows x
WHERE x.proxy_status_scope = '${proxy_scope}'
  AND $__timeFilter(x.captured_at)
  AND x.last_ip != '__snapshot_empty__'
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM proxies p
    WHERE p.location IN ($location)
      AND LOCATE(CONCAT(' | ', p.device_id, ' | '), CONCAT(' | ', COALESCE(x.device_ids, ''), ' | ')) > 0
  )

panels.title: Duplicated IPs Detected

panels.description: Distinct phones from selected locations that appeared in at least one duplicate-IP snapshot during the selected time range.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.device_id) AS value
FROM duplicate_ip_snapshot_rows x
JOIN proxies p
  ON p.location IN ($location)
  AND LOCATE(CONCAT(' | ', p.device_id, ' | '), CONCAT(' | ', COALESCE(x.device_ids, ''), ' | ')) > 0
WHERE x.proxy_status_scope = '${proxy_scope}'
  AND $__timeFilter(x.captured_at)
  AND x.last_ip != '__snapshot_empty__'

panels.title: Phones Affected

panels.description: Percentage of duplicate IP scan rows where all phones sharing the IP were on one server label.

targets.rawSql:
WITH filtered_rows AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT x.captured_at, x.last_ip
  FROM duplicate_ip_snapshot_rows x
  JOIN proxies p
    ON p.location IN ($location)
    AND LOCATE(CONCAT(' | ', p.device_id, ' | '), CONCAT(' | ', COALESCE(x.device_ids, ''), ' | ')) > 0
  WHERE x.proxy_status_scope = '${proxy_scope}'
    AND $__timeFilter(x.captured_at)
    AND x.last_ip != '__snapshot_empty__'
), row_scope AS (
  SELECT
    fr.captured_at,
    fr.last_ip,
    COUNT(DISTINCT s.server_label) AS server_count
  FROM filtered_rows fr
  JOIN duplicate_ip_snapshot_servers s
    ON s.captured_at = fr.captured_at
    AND s.proxy_status_scope = '${proxy_scope}'
    AND s.last_ip = fr.last_ip
  GROUP BY fr.captured_at, fr.last_ip
)
SELECT COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN server_count = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2), 0) AS value
FROM row_scope

panels.title: % Within Same Server

panels.description: Percentage of duplicate IP scan rows where the same IP appeared on more than one server label.

targets.rawSql:
WITH filtered_rows AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT x.captured_at, x.last_ip
  FROM duplicate_ip_snapshot_rows x
  JOIN proxies p
    ON p.location IN ($location)
    AND LOCATE(CONCAT(' | ', p.device_id, ' | '), CONCAT(' | ', COALESCE(x.device_ids, ''), ' | ')) > 0
  WHERE x.proxy_status_scope = '${proxy_scope}'
    AND $__timeFilter(x.captured_at)
    AND x.last_ip != '__snapshot_empty__'
), row_scope AS (
  SELECT
    fr.captured_at,
    fr.last_ip,
    COUNT(DISTINCT s.server_label) AS server_count
  FROM filtered_rows fr
  JOIN duplicate_ip_snapshot_servers s
    ON s.captured_at = fr.captured_at
    AND s.proxy_status_scope = '${proxy_scope}'
    AND s.last_ip = fr.last_ip
  GROUP BY fr.captured_at, fr.last_ip
)
SELECT COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN server_count > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2), 0) AS value
FROM row_scope

panels.title: % Across Servers

panels.description: Average daily affected-phone rate across the selected time range. Each 24h group counts distinct selected-location phones that appeared in duplicate snapshots that day.

targets.rawSql:
WITH active_proxy_count AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_phones
  FROM proxies
  WHERE active = true
    AND location IN ($location)
), daily_affected AS (
  SELECT
    DATE(x.captured_at) AS scan_day,
    COUNT(DISTINCT p.device_id) AS affected_phones
  FROM duplicate_ip_snapshot_rows x
  JOIN proxies p
    ON p.location IN ($location)
    AND LOCATE(CONCAT(' | ', p.device_id, ' | '), CONCAT(' | ', COALESCE(x.device_ids, ''), ' | ')) > 0
  WHERE x.proxy_status_scope = '${proxy_scope}'
    AND $__timeFilter(x.captured_at)
    AND x.last_ip != '__snapshot_empty__'
  GROUP BY DATE(x.captured_at)
)
SELECT COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(daily_affected.affected_phones * 100.0 / NULLIF(active_proxy_count.total_phones, 0)), 2), 0) AS value
FROM daily_affected
CROSS JOIN active_proxy_count

panels.title: Avg 24h Dup Rate
Duplicate Details by Location, Server, and Phone

panels.description: Phone-level duplicate-IP evidence for the selected locations and time range. The table keeps each affected phone separate so duplicate exposure can be reviewed by location, IP, and server.

targets.rawSql:
WITH phone_scan AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    x.captured_at,
    x.last_ip,
    p.location,
    p.device_id,
    p.name AS phone_name,
    CASE
      WHEN UPPER(TRIM(p.name)) REGEXP '^S[0-9]{1,3}(P[0-9]+|[[:space:]_-]+P[0-9]+)' THEN REGEXP_SUBSTR(UPPER(TRIM(p.name)), '^S[0-9]{1,3}')
      ELSE 'UNKNOWN'
    END AS server_label,
    x.phones_on_same_ip,
    x.all_servers_on_ip,
    x.sibling_phones
  FROM duplicate_ip_snapshot_rows x
  JOIN proxies p
    ON p.location IN ($location)
    AND LOCATE(CONCAT(' | ', p.device_id, ' | '), CONCAT(' | ', COALESCE(x.device_ids, ''), ' | ')) > 0
  WHERE x.proxy_status_scope = '${proxy_scope}'
    AND $__timeFilter(x.captured_at)
    AND x.last_ip != '__snapshot_empty__'
), ip_scope AS (
  SELECT
    ps.captured_at,
    ps.last_ip,
    COUNT(DISTINCT s.server_label) AS server_count
  FROM phone_scan ps
  JOIN duplicate_ip_snapshot_servers s
    ON s.captured_at = ps.captured_at
    AND s.proxy_status_scope = '${proxy_scope}'
    AND s.last_ip = ps.last_ip
  GROUP BY ps.captured_at, ps.last_ip
)
SELECT
  ps.location,
  ps.last_ip,
  ps.server_label,
  ps.phone_name,
  ps.device_id,
  CASE WHEN MAX(ip_scope.server_count) > 1 THEN 'across_servers' ELSE 'within_server' END AS dup_scope,
  COUNT(DISTINCT ps.captured_at) AS scan_appearances,
  MIN(ps.captured_at) AS first_seen,
  MAX(ps.captured_at) AS last_seen,
  MAX(ps.phones_on_same_ip) AS max_phones_on_ip,
  MAX(ps.all_servers_on_ip) AS all_servers_on_ip,
  MAX(ps.sibling_phones) AS sibling_phones
FROM phone_scan ps
JOIN ip_scope
  ON ip_scope.captured_at = ps.captured_at
  AND ip_scope.last_ip = ps.last_ip
GROUP BY ps.location, ps.last_ip, ps.server_label, ps.phone_name, ps.device_id
ORDER BY scan_appearances DESC, max_phones_on_ip DESC, ps.location, ps.server_label, ps.phone_name
LIMIT 1000

panels.title: Duplicated Phones in Selected Time Range

panels.description: One point per day per selected location. The value is the number of distinct duplicated IPs observed that day for phones in that location.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  UNIX_TIMESTAMP(scan_day) AS time_sec,
  location AS metric,
  duplicate_ips AS value
FROM (
  SELECT
    DATE(x.captured_at) AS scan_day,
    p.location,
    COUNT(DISTINCT x.last_ip) AS duplicate_ips
  FROM duplicate_ip_snapshot_rows x
  JOIN proxies p
    ON p.location IN ($location)
    AND LOCATE(CONCAT(' | ', p.device_id, ' | '), CONCAT(' | ', COALESCE(x.device_ids, ''), ' | ')) > 0
  WHERE x.proxy_status_scope = '${proxy_scope}'
    AND $__timeFilter(x.captured_at)
    AND x.last_ip != '__snapshot_empty__'
  GROUP BY DATE(x.captured_at), p.location
) daily
ORDER BY time_sec, metric
